title: One planned task
description: One element of the plan's tasks collection, and the whole input to one implement member phase. The id is the fan-out identity: senawa names the member phase from it and detects added, changed, and removed elements across replans by it.

task.description: What to change. Detail beyond this belongs in the plan document.

dependsOn.description: Other task ids in the same collection that must finish first.

targets.description: Paths this task is expected to touch. A hint for the agent, not a restriction senawa enforces.

verification.description: How a reviewer would know this task worked.
